title.ja: 図1-1 原始棒銀の基本
title.en: Figure 1-1: Basics of the primitive Climbing Silver

explain.ja: 図1-1は、棒銀の中でも最も基本的な「原始棒銀」の基本図です。飛車・銀・歩の3枚が縦に並ぶのが特徴で、この3枚を連携させて攻めます。基本的にはこの形から飛車を前に進めて龍を作ることを狙います。狙いは単純で、銀を繰り出して2筋の道を開け、飛車を龍に成らせることです。
explain.en: Figure 1-1 is the basic diagram of "primitive" Climbing Silver, the most basic Bogin. Its feature is rook, silver and pawn lined up on one file, attacking in coordination. The aim from this shape is to advance the rook and make a dragon. The aim is simple: bring out the silver, open the 2nd file and promote the rook into a dragon.

title.ja: 図2-1 後手は3二の金で2筋を守る
title.en: Figure 2-1: White defends the 2nd file with the gold on 3二

explain.ja: ここでは棒銀の最も基本的な成功例を見ます。図2-1では、後手は3二の金で2筋からの攻めを守ろうとしています。飛車1枚で攻めると失敗する形ですが、銀と組み合わせて攻める様子を見ます。局面を分かりやすくするため、盤の一部の駒だけを示します。
explain.en: Here we see the most basic success of Climbing Silver. In Figure 2-1 White tries to guard against an attack on the 2nd file with the gold on 3二. A rook alone would fail, but we see how combining it with the silver works. For clarity only some of the board's pieces are shown.

section.ja: わかりやすい棒銀の攻め方
section.en: A clear way to attack with Bouginu

title.ja: 図2-2 銀は端から使うのが基本
title.en: Figure 2-2: Silver is basically used from the edge

explain.ja: 図2-1からは、▲1五銀と端から銀を使うのが基本です。次に後手が△1四歩と突くと銀を攻められて意味がないようにも見えますが、ここから棒銀の手筋があります。
explain.en: From Figure 2-1 the basic idea is to use the silver from the edge with ▲1五銀. White's next △1四歩 seems to attack the silver and make it pointless, but a Climbing Silver tesuji follows.

section.en: Use the silver from the edge

title.ja: 図2-3 銀取りに構わず2筋を攻める
title.en: Figure 2-3: Ignore the silver threat and attack on the 2nd file

explain.ja: 図2-2から△1四歩と銀を攻められても、構わず▲2四歩と攻めるのがポイントです。せっかく進めた銀が取られそうですが、さらに数手進めます。
explain.en: Even if White attacks the silver with △1四歩 in Figure 2-2, the point is to ignore it and attack with ▲2四歩. The advanced silver seems about to be lost, but play a few more moves.

section.en: Use the silver from the edge

title.ja: 図2-4 角金両取りのと金
title.en: Figure 2-4: Tokin forking bishop and gold

explain.ja: △1五歩と銀を取られても、次の▲2三歩成が角金両取りになります。後手は角を逃げれば金を取られ、金を逃げれば角を取られる形です。銀は取られますが、角か金のどちらかが取れる形になります。
explain.en: Even if White captures the silver with △1五歩, ▲2三歩成 next forks bishop and gold. If White saves the bishop the gold is lost, and vice versa. The silver is lost but either bishop or gold will be won.

section.ja: 銀を取られても、相手の金を取れる
section.en: Even if the silver is captured, you can capture the opponent's gold

title.ja: 図2-5 狙いの飛車成が成功！
title.en: Figure 2-5: The intended rook promotion succeeds!

explain.ja: 図2-4から後手が仕方なく△2三金とと金を取ってきても、▲同飛成で飛車を龍に成らせることに成功します。結果的に銀は取られたものの金を取れたので、駒得の形です。見事に棒銀が成功しました。
explain.en: From Figure 2-4, even if White reluctantly captures the tokin with △2三金, ▲同飛成 promotes the rook into a dragon. The silver is lost, but a gold is won, so Black is up in material. Climbing Silver succeeded.

section.ja: 銀を取られても、相手の金を取れる
section.en: Even if the silver is captured, you can capture the opponent's gold

title.ja: 図2-6 銀を前に進める

explain.ja: 図2-3から後手が銀を取らず△2四歩と歩を取ってきた場合は、単に▲同銀と銀を進めれば攻めが成功します。次に▲2四銀成、△同金、▲同飛成と進んで飛車を成れれば攻めが決まります。図2-6では2三に利いている駒が先手2枚、後手1枚で、これが数の攻めです。
explain.en: If, from Figure 2-3, White does not take the silver but captures the pawn with △2四歩, simply advancing the silver with ▲同銀 makes the attack succeed. Then ▲2四銀成, △同金, ▲同飛成 promotes the rook and settles it. In Figure 2-6, Black has two pieces controlling 2三 against White's one: a numbers attack.

section.ja: 後手が銀を取ってこなかったら?
section.en: When White does not capture the silver?

title.en: Figure a-1: Use the silver from the 3rd file

explain.ja: 図2-1からは、▲3五歩、△同歩、▲同銀と攻める方法もあります。銀を5段目まで進出させれば、そこから▲2四歩で2筋を攻められます。たとえば後手があらかじめ1四歩を突いていた場合に有効で、相手の形を見て端から行くか3筋から行くか決めます。
explain.en: From Figure 2-1 there is also the method ▲3五歩, △同歩, ▲同銀. With the silver on the fifth rank, you can then attack the 2nd file with ▲2四歩. It is effective, for instance, if White has already pushed the 1四 pawn; judge the opponent's formation to decide whether to go from the edge or from the 3rd file.

section.ja: 後手が銀を取ってこなかったら?
section.en: When White does not capture the silver?

title.ja: 図3-1 棒銀の応用の攻め

explain.ja: 棒銀の基本の攻めを覚えたら、応用編に進みます。△3三銀として守りを固められたときの指し方や、端を絡めた攻めの手筋を学びます。
explain.en: After learning the basic Climbing Silver attack, move on to applications: how to play when White solidifies with △3三銀, and tesuji involving the edge.

section.ja: 棒銀が簡単に成功しないときは!?銀交換からの攻め方や端攻め
section.en: When Rushing Silver doesn't succeed easily! Attacking after a silver exchange and edge attacks

title.ja: 図3-2 振り飛車を対策する

explain.ja: 相手が振り飛車に構えてきたときの攻め筋を学びましょう。振り飛車では角を使って受けてくることが多いですが、棒銀で攻める手順があります。初心者から初級者の戦いでは振り飛車が相手になることが多いです。
explain.en: Learn how to attack when the opponent plays Ranging Rook. Ranging Rook often defends using the bishop, but there are Climbing Silver sequences to attack. Beginner to intermediate games often face Ranging Rook.

section.ja: 振り飛車を攻略しよう!角で受けられた時の攻め方
section.en: Beat Ranging Rook! How to attack when it is met with a bishop

explain.ja: 攻めの手順を覚えたら、守りの形も練習しましょう。棒銀でよく使われる囲いをまとめています。相手の攻めの形に合わせて囲いを使い分けるのがおすすめです。
explain.en: After learning the attack, practise the defensive formations too. The castles often used with Climbing Silver are collected, and it is recommended to choose a castle according to the opponent's attacking formation.

section.ja: 棒銀ではどんな囲いが使われる?
section.en: What castles are used with Rushing Silver?

explain.ja: 相居飛車で棒銀を指すなら、まず矢倉棒銀に挑戦しましょう。攻めと守りのバランスがよく、初心者から上級者まで使えます。矢倉囲いと棒銀で攻めも守りもしっかりできます。
explain.en: If you play Climbing Silver in double Static Rook, start with Yagura Climbing Silver. It balances attack and defence and suits beginners to advanced players. Yagura plus Climbing Silver covers both attack and defence.

section.ja: 矢倉棒銀の定跡 相居飛車の基本の棒銀を学ぶ
section.en: Yagura Climbing Silver joseki: learn the basic Climbing Silver in Static Rook vs Static Rook

explain.ja: 相居飛車で角交換する戦法が角換わりです。角換わり棒銀は矢倉棒銀より激しい戦いになりやすく、初心者には難しい変化もありますが、攻撃力は抜群です。
explain.en: Bishop Exchange is the strategy of exchanging bishops in double Static Rook. Bishop Exchange Climbing Silver tends to be fiercer than Yagura Climbing Silver, with variations difficult for beginners, but its attacking power is outstanding.

section.ja: 角換わり棒銀の定跡 角交換からの棒銀
section.en: Bishop Exchange Climbing Silver joseki: Climbing Silver after the bishop exchange

title.ja: 図4-3 相掛かり棒銀(UFO銀)
title.en: Figure 4-3: Double Wing Attack Climbing Silver (UFO Silver)

explain.ja: 相掛かりは、角道を開けずに飛車先をどんどん伸ばしていく相居飛車の戦法です。相掛かりの棒銀は力戦・乱戦になりやすいですが、受け方を知らない相手ならあっさり勝てることもあります。居飛車党ならこの変化は覚えておきましょう。
explain.en: Aigakari (Rook Fight) is a double Static Rook strategy that extends the rook pawns steadily without opening the bishop's diagonal. Climbing Silver there tends to lead to brawls, but it can win easily against an opponent who doesn't know the defence. Static Rook players should know this variation.

section.ja: 相掛かり棒銀 角道を開けずに棒銀で攻めろ!
section.en: Aigakari Climbing Silver: attack with Climbing Silver without opening the bishop diagonal

title.en: Figure 4-4: Climbing Silver against Ranging Rook

explain.ja: 四間飛車など振り飛車相手に棒銀で戦う定跡を見ます。上級者相手では棒銀の攻めは簡単には決まらず、難解な変化になりがちです。
explain.en: See the joseki for fighting Ranging Rook such as Fourth File Rook with Climbing Silver. Against strong opponents the attack is not easy to land and tends to become complex.

section.ja: 対振り棒銀 四間飛車を棒銀で対策!
section.en: Against Ranging Rook: Rushing Silver. Counter Fourth File Rook with Rushing Silver!

title.ja: 図5-1 矢倉で速攻棒銀を受ける
title.en: Figure 5-1: Receiving a fast Climbing Silver with Yagura

explain.ja: 棒銀の攻め方を覚えたら、今度は相手から棒銀で攻められたときの受け方を見ます。まず居飛車で棒銀を受ける手順で、矢倉囲いで速攻棒銀と戦います。
explain.en: After learning how to attack with Climbing Silver, see how to defend when attacked by it. First is the Static Rook way of defending, fighting a fast Climbing Silver with a Yagura castle.

section.ja: 居飛車で速攻棒銀を受ける
section.en: Meeting the fast Rushing Silver with a Static Rook

title.ja: 図5-2 四間飛車で棒銀を受ける
title.en: Figure 5-2: Receiving Climbing Silver with Fourth File Rook

explain.ja: 今度は四間飛車で棒銀を受ける手順です。速攻で棒銀を仕掛ける順に対しては、基本的に四間飛車が優勢になります。どんな戦法を指す場合も、棒銀対策はしっかりしておきたいところです。
explain.en: Now the way to defend against Climbing Silver with Fourth File Rook. Against a fast Climbing Silver, Fourth File Rook is basically better. Whatever strategy you play, you should be well prepared against Climbing Silver.

section.ja: 四間飛車で速攻棒銀を受ける
section.en: Defend against a fast Bouginu with Fourth File Rook

title.ja: 図5-3 嬉野流で棒銀を受ける
title.en: Figure 5-3: Receiving Climbing Silver with the Ureshino style

explain.ja: 嬉野流という少し変わった戦法でも、棒銀は大敵です。嬉野流を指したいなら、棒銀への対策方法をしっかり学んでおきましょう。嬉野流では少し変わった受け方をします。
explain.en: Even for the unusual Ureshino-style strategy, Climbing Silver is a major enemy. If you want to play Ureshino style, study the countermeasures against Climbing Silver; it uses a slightly unusual defence.

section.ja: 嬉野流で棒銀を受ける
section.en: Defending against Rushing Silver with the Ureshino school
